//: code-intel tool plans for corpus.golden.json (CTX-S2), read by scripts/workflow-bench.ts --corpus. Same shape as orders_app.plans.json, keyed by question id. Each step is what an agent would call to answer the question, and `from` says which part of the question it serves. There are no `services`: corpus mode takes the repos from config/repos.json and queries the graph already built from them.
//requires: A step marked `requires: CTX-Sn` names a tool that slice adds. The bench runs it only when the server lists that tool, and otherwise prints it as skipped; tests/workflow-bench.test.ts accepts a tool not in src/mcp/server.ts only with this mark. error_trace's arguments follow the CTX-S13 worktree's inputSchema (service, method, path); find_workflow's argument name is not fixed yet and CTX-S8 corrects it. The slice that adds a tool also removes the stand-in steps its tool replaces, in the same commit, so the bench delta is attributable to it.
//args: No argument contains a fact's evidence (tests/workflow-bench.test.ts checks this): a response that echoes its request, such as a not-found message, would otherwise credit the fact. That is why po_endpoint_flow asks endpoint_flow alone and does not seed context_pack with proxyToEngine, one of its facts.

not_indexed.reason: PROCUREMENT_BASE_URL's target (Q1.5) is not in config/repos.json; the graph cannot follow that branch, and only traces can tell which branch is live (plan §4.2)
